name: Kristijan
site: salzburg-ag.at · Energy, transport and telecom, Austria
headline: Turn Salzburg AG’s usage data into contracts that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells electricity tariffs, a 6 months free internet offer and a social tariff to every visitor the same way, whether they come for business power, e-mobility or a customer login.

Once a customer logs in, what they consume, when they switch tariffs and which offers they never open is your strongest signal for the next upgrade or cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and anti-churn campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. A household about to leave this week gets the same tariff letter as everyone else, or none at all, though family offers already sit on your site.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Per customer, the AI reads tariff changes, Kundenportal logins and service contacts to spot who is about to leave. It picks the right offer, channel and moment for each household.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right tariff to each customer
cases.text: Next best tariff or add-on per customer, triggered by what they already use, so families, business customers and existing subscribers each see a relevant offer, never a blanket mail.

cases.head: Keep customers engaged, every week
cases.text: Personal nudges in your Kundenportal, email and newsletter show each customer the savings, tools and services they have not used yet, so every household has a reason to log in.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
